messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-02-11, the feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team; ownership transferred from the Ember team on that date, and the Dune team never owned it. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: As of 2026-02-11, the feature-flags service is owned by the Dune team; ownership transferred from the Ember team on that date. [decision; valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-06, the feature-flags service is owned by the Ember team; ownership transferred from the Atlas team on that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-06 to 2026-02-11; recorded by handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-06; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- On 2025-12-31, the Atlas team observed that the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- Clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, decided at the Atlas standup on 2025-09-02. [decision; valid 2025-09-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-02]
- The Atlas team owns the image resizer as of 2025-11-26, when ownership transferred from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the image resizer as of 2025-03-20. [decision; valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the image resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- Oskar wrote up the feature-flags handover doc for Farah on 2026-02-11. [valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
- As of 2026-01-12, the billing API is owned by the Ember team, having been run by the Atlas team until then. [decision; valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-12-billing-api]
    earlier: The Atlas team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to 2026-01-12; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-06-09 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the billing API as of 2025-03-07, when ownership passed from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-03-07 to 2025-06-09; recorded by handover/2025-03-07-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-07; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- The Ember team does pairing on every production change. [decision; valid 2025-02-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06-2]
- The Cinder team reported on 2025-04-24 that feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-04-24 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2]
- As of 2025-12-05, the reporting service is owned by the Ember team, having transferred from the Dune team. [decision; valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
    earlier: The reporting service is a Dune team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-12-05; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- The Ember team handed the authentication gateway to Cinder on 2025-09-16; Cinder owns it as of that date. [decision; valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the authentication gateway. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-09-16; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- The feature-flags service saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, most of them identical, as of 2025-09-02. [valid 2025-09-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-02]
- The job scheduler depends on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-29]
- The Ember team runs its planning on Fridays. [valid 2025-07-21 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-07-21]
- The Ember team is a one-person team consisting of Oskar. [valid 2025-01-10 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-10]
- On 2025-12-19, the Atlas team took over the product catalog from the Cinder team. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
